title: Assistance Beyond Lift Access Housing Grant for Seniors and Those with Mobility Issues who Live in HDB Flats Lacking Direct Lift Access
what_it_is: Assistance Beyond Lift Access Housing Grant for Seniors and Those with Mobility Issues who Live in HDB Flats Lacking Direct Lift Access

sections.label: Housing options for seniors
sections.summary: Seniors with mobility and financial difficulties can consider a Community Care Apartment or a 2-room Flexi flat on a shorter lease.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For seniors with mobility difficulties who face financial difficulties, they can consider purchasing a Community Care Apartment or a 2-room Flexi flat on a shorter lease.

sections.label: Silver Housing Bonus and LHG
sections.summary: Seniors who right-size to a 3-room or smaller HDB flat and top up sale proceeds into their CPF Retirement Account can get a Silver Housing Bonus of up to $30,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In addition to the LHG, of up to $30,000 for families and $15,000 for singles, seniors who right-size to a 3-room or smaller Housing and Development Board (HDB) flat and top up the proceeds from the sale of their existing property into their Central Provident Fund (CPF) Retirement Account, can additionally benefit from the Silver Housing Bonus of up to $30,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Since the implementation of LHG in 2020, HDB has received 67 complete applications.

sections.label: Lift Upgrading Programme progress
sections.summary: Almost all, in excess of 5,000 blocks of flats, have undergone LUP, with some 140 blocks left.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Today, almost all, in excess of 5,000 blocks of flats, have undergone LUP, with some 140 blocks left that have not undergone LUP.

sections.label: Jalan Kayu lift access blocks
sections.summary: About 10 out of 142 blocks under Jalan Kayu have a lift access issue, which is less than 10%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I have a group of residents with this issue.

sentences.speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I have about 10 out of 142 blocks that are under the care of Jalan Kayu, that have got the lift access issue, so it is less than 10%.

sections.label: Cost of lift access
sections.summary: Some cases require significant cost, sometimes well over $100,000 per unit, beyond what other households receive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Some of them require a significant cost, well beyond what is provided to all the other households to get the lift – sometimes in excess of well over $100,000 per unit even.

sections.label: Alternative lift methods rejected
sections.summary: Vertical platform lifts and pneumatic vacuum elevators were piloted, but in 2017 it was decided not to proceed as they were not effective.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We have also tried things, like vertical platform lifts and pneumatic vacuum elevators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But in 2017, after trying a pilot for these different methods, we decided not to proceed because they were not effective.

sections.label: Helping residents with access
sections.summary: The speaker says they favour helping residents with access, noting blocks went from 5,300 in 2001 to 140, and they continue to find ways to help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We lean in favour of trying to help residents with access where possible.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And that is why out of 5,300 blocks at the start of the exercise in 2001, we now have 140; and we continue to try to find ways to help.
